VALUE In Progress ~198 million EGP DISCIPLINES Urban Planning & Design Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This ongoing residential project in Cairo for SODIC and CIB involves the construction of 7 housing units, 2 transformers, and a full basement, spanning 9,400 square meters across a high ground floor, three upper floors, and a rooftop. Reviewing drawings, monitoring progress, project scheduling, cash flow management, and ensuring quality and HSE compliance.
